Hocking County is located in South Eastern Ohio at Coordinates 39.50 N by 82.48 W and was founded on March 1, 1818. Hocking County is home to approximately 28,097 people as of the 2020 Census . Hocking County is named after the Hocking River which comes from the Delaware Indian word for Bottle River.
Hocking County is divided into the townships Benton, Falls, Good Hope, Green, Laurel, Marion, Perry, Salt Creek, Starr, Ward and Washington. The County seat is the City of Logan
